cases.expected: instance of JsonSchema representing the supplied schema
cases.description: When a non‑null InputStream containing a well‑formed JSON schema and a non‑null SchemaValidatorsConfig are supplied, getSchema should parse the stream and return a JsonSchema object.
If the config argument is null the method should fall back to the factory’s default SchemaValidatorsConfig and still return a JsonSchema.
A null InputStream is not acceptable; the method must throw a NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) before attempting to read.
Both arguments null – the method should still fail fast with a NullPointerException.

cases.expected: IOException or JsonProcessingException indicating empty content
cases.description: An InputStream with no bytes cannot be parsed into a JSON tree; the method should propagate an IOException (or a Jackson parsing exception).

cases.expected: IOException or JsonProcessingException indicating malformed JSON
cases.description: When the stream contains syntactically invalid JSON, getSchema must throw an exception from the underlying JsonNodeReader.

cases.expected: IOException or JsonProcessingException because the default InputFormat is JSON
cases.description: Supplying a YAML document while the method forces InputFormat.JSON should result in a parsing failure.

A well‑formed JSON schema stream together with a non‑default SchemaValidatorsConfig (e.g., typeLoose and failFast enabled). The factory must return a JsonSchema object that has been created using the supplied configuration.
The InputStream starts with a UTF‑8 Byte Order Mark (BOM) followed by a valid JSON schema. The method should ignore the BOM and successfully parse the schema.
A valid JSON schema that contains extra whitespace characters after the closing brace. With a null config the factory falls back to its default configuration and must still return a JsonSchema.

cases.expected: IOException or JsonProcessingException indicating empty content
cases.description: An empty InputStream with a null config should behave the same as with a non‑null config: the method must propagate an exception because there is no content to parse.

cases.expected: IOException or JsonProcessingException indicating malformed JSON
cases.description: A stream containing syntactically invalid JSON together with a null config must still result in a parsing exception.

cases.expected: IOException or JsonProcessingException because the default InputFormat is JSON
cases.description: Supplying a YAML document while the method forces InputFormat.JSON and passing a null config should still cause a parsing failure.
The InputStream throws an IOException during read(). The method must not swallow the exception; it should propagate it to the caller.
The InputStream has already been closed before being passed to getSchema. Attempting to read should result in an IOException that is propagated.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or RuntimeException) indicating that $ref could not be resolved
cases.description: The InputStream contains a valid JSON schema that includes a $ref to a non‑existent external schema. The factory should attempt to resolve the reference during loading and throw an exception because the reference cannot be found.
